'''''Buffalo''''' was a pair of [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] traveling through the [[Petrakis system/Legends|Petrakis system]] carrying [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] used a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] to disable the [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. However, a group of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]] arrived to destroy him for his actions. He fought them off as transport group Ninja boarded the freighters and escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
